items.title: MCO applies employee trading oversight to prediction markets in compliance platform update
items.content_text: - **MCO applies employee trading oversight to prediction markets in compliance platform update** — BusinessWire reports MyComplianceOffice announced new capabilities that apply its personal trading and digital asset controls to prediction market activity, alongside expanded communications surveillance for platforms including Telegram and Slack. items.title: Kalshi rolls out perpetual futures contract based on 500-stock index
items.content_text: - **Kalshi rolls out perpetual futures contract based on 500-stock index** — MoneyCheck reports Kalshi launched a perpetual futures contract on October 6 tracking an index of 500 major U.S. companies derived from the MerQube US Large Cap Index. The contract has no expiration date and uses a funding rate mechanism to keep its price aligned with the underlying index. items.title: Robinhood calls prediction markets the fastest-growing business in its history
items.content_text: - **Robinhood calls prediction markets the fastest-growing business in its history** — GambleRss reports Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev described prediction markets as the fastest-growing business in the company history, with more than 12 billion event contracts traded on the platform in 2025 and volume more than doubling in the fourth quarter. Tenev also pointed to strong non-sports contract volume, including a government shutdown market, after the NFL season ended. ([GambleRss](https://gamblerss.com/robinhood-prediction-markets-are-the-fastest-growing-business-in-our-history-56769))

items.title: U.S. pro sports split on prediction markets as NFL backs New Jersey case and NBA move draws focus
items.content_text: - **U.S. pro sports split on prediction markets as NFL backs New Jersey case and NBA move draws focus** — Digital Today reports the NFL filed an amicus brief backing New Jersey in its case against Kalshi, arguing sports contracts are gambling, while other leagues weigh partnerships. The filing cited 1.8 billion dollars of 3.3 billion dollars in opening-weekend prediction market volume concentrated on NFL games. items.title: Kalshi stays legal in Florida as DeSantis questions prediction market boundary
items.content_text: - **Kalshi stays legal in Florida as DeSantis questions prediction market boundary** — Covers explains Kalshi operates in Florida as a CFTC-regulated exchange rather than a state-licensed sportsbook, while Hard Rock Bet remains the only legal online sportsbook under the Seminole compact. Governor Ron DeSantis has publicly questioned whether sports event contracts conflict with the tribe's exclusive sports betting rights. items.title: Polymarket whale loses about 147,000 dollars on Eagles bet after last-second Jaguars field goal
items.content_text: - **Polymarket whale loses about 147,000 dollars on Eagles bet after last-second Jaguars field goal** — CoinSpectator reports a Polymarket trader put about 146,700 dollars on the Philadelphia Eagles and stood to receive 623,449 dollars before Jacksonville won 19 to 17 on a 57-yard field goal as time expired in London. The contract moved from 23 cents to 99 cents before settling at zero. ([CoinSpectator](https://coinspectator.com/bitcoin-com/2026/10/12/polymarket-whale-loses-147k-eagles-bet-after-a-last-second-57-yard-kick/))

items.title: Analysis says Kalshi Ninth Circuit ruling leaves CFTC event-contract rule in limbo
items.content_text: - **Analysis says Kalshi Ninth Circuit ruling leaves CFTC event-contract rule in limbo** — An analysis of the circuit split notes the Third Circuit reached the opposite conclusion on Kalshi contracts in April, while a New York court assumed the contracts could be swaps but held federal jurisdiction does not preempt state gaming rules. It says the CFTC proposed rulemaking would add a 90-day public-interest review for contracts touching gaming and other listed activities. items.title: Kalshi files for Ohio and Tennessee rehearings based on CFTC new swaps rule
items.content_text: - **Kalshi files for Ohio and Tennessee rehearings based on CFTC new swaps rule** — Kalshi filed a motion for rehearing in the Sixth Circuit citing the CFTC Notice of Proposed Rulemaking published October 9, which seeks to include sports, politics, cultural and weather event contracts in the definition of swaps. The Sixth Circuit had ruled in September that Ohio and Tennessee could regulate Kalshi sports contracts under state gambling laws. items.content_text: - **TRUEiGTECH upgrades prediction market platform for multi-million event concurrency** — TRUEiGTECH announced on October 14 an infrastructure upgrade to its prediction market platform, adding in-memory order books, partitioned event pipelines and automated settlement using multiple oracles. items.title: NBER study finds no systematic political bias in election prediction market prices
items.content_text: - **NBER study finds no systematic political bias in election prediction market prices** — An October 2026 NBER working paper by Eric Zitzewitz examined election prediction markets spanning 1880 to 2025, described as the largest sample of its kind. The study found no systematic partisan or demographic bias in election prices over the long run. items.title: Kalshi files to end volume reward program as Ether trade scrutiny grows
items.content_text: - **Kalshi files to end volume reward program as Ether trade scrutiny grows** — Kalshi filed with the CFTC to end its Volume Incentive Program no earlier than October 13, after September trading volume reached 52.98 billion dollars through September 29. Reports say the CFTC is reviewing more than 5 billion dollars in repeated Ether perpetual futures trades, which Kalshi says came from market makers and fast traders hitting quotes. items.title: Midterm election betting surges on Polymarket and Kalshi as insider-trading concerns persist
items.content_text: - **Midterm election betting surges on Polymarket and Kalshi as insider-trading concerns persist** — Reuters reported on October 14 that trading on U.S. midterm outcomes has surged this year on Polymarket and Kalshi, covering control of Congress and individual races. Platforms say they block election trades by politicians and campaign workers and refer misconduct cases to authorities, while critics warn the markets could affect faith in election integrity. items.title: Kalshi asks full Sixth Circuit to review panel decision favoring Ohio and Tennessee officials
items.content_text: - **Kalshi asks full Sixth Circuit to review panel decision favoring Ohio and Tennessee officials** — Kalshi filed a request on October 13 for the full Sixth Circuit to rehear its Ohio and Tennessee cases, arguing the panel misinterpreted the Commodity Exchange Act on two points. The panel had let both states apply gambling laws to Kalshi sports contracts, and Kalshi is reserving a possible Supreme Court appeal. items.title: Ohio leads 39-state coalition urging Supreme Court review of prediction market case
items.content_text: - **Ohio leads 39-state coalition urging Supreme Court review of prediction market case** — Ohio Attorney General D. Andrew Wilson led 39 states and the District of Columbia in an October 7 amicus brief asking the Supreme Court to decide whether state gambling laws apply to sports event contracts on federally regulated platforms. The brief cites the split between the Third and Sixth Circuits over federal preemption. items.title: Election betting booms ahead of midterms as states weigh power to curb prediction markets
items.content_text: - **Election betting booms ahead of midterms as states weigh power to curb prediction markets** — Election betting is surging as the midterms near, while states question whether they can curb the platforms. items.title: Most Americans oppose betting on elections and government events, Reuters/Ipsos poll finds
items.content_text: - **Most Americans oppose betting on elections and government events, Reuters/Ipsos poll finds** — A Reuters/Ipsos poll conducted September 30 to October 5 found a bipartisan majority opposed to prediction market betting on government affairs, with 69 percent of Democrats and 61 percent of Republicans opposing election betting. Opposition reached 65 percent for bets on U.S. military actions and 63 percent for bets on government policy decisions. ([Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/world/most-americans-oppose-betting-elections-government-events-reutersipsos-poll-2026-10-12/))

items.title: CFTC rule draws line between gambling and prediction market contracts
items.content_text: - **CFTC rule draws line between gambling and prediction market contracts** — The CFTC issued an interim final rule on October 9 that excludes traditional sports wagers and casino games from the definition of a swap. A separate proposed rule would classify event contracts tied to sports, politics, culture and weather as swaps under CFTC oversight, with a 30-day comment period after Federal Register publication. ([TokenPost](https://www.tokenpost.com/news/regulation/29261))

items.title: Prediction market volume reaches record 78.2 billion dollars in September on sports trading growth
items.content_text: - **Prediction market volume reaches record 78.2 billion dollars in September on sports trading growth** — Prediction markets posted a record 78.2 billion dollars in notional volume in September, passing the previous high of 56.4 billion dollars set in July, as sports trading rebounded after a late-summer slowdown. Weekly volume recovered to about 19.9 billion dollars after slipping to roughly 10 billion dollars from late July to mid-August. items.title: Kalshi clearinghouse files to add leverage to event contracts in push for institutional traders
items.content_text: - **Kalshi clearinghouse files to add leverage to event contracts in push for institutional traders** — Kalshi Klear, the prediction market's internal clearinghouse, has submitted a regulatory filing seeking permission to offer leverage on event contracts, a step aimed at drawing more institutional liquidity to the platform. Leverage would let traders take positions larger than their cash deposits alone would allow, and the change still needs to clear the regulatory process. items.content_text: - **Coinbase launches crypto price prediction markets with contracts as short as 15 minutes** — Coinbase opened crypto price prediction markets to US users on October 6, covering Bitcoin, Ether, Solana, BNB and other assets with time frames as brief as 15 minutes. items.title: Prediction markets top $10 billion in record weekend volume, led by Kalshi
items.content_text: - **Prediction markets top $10 billion in record weekend volume, led by Kalshi** — Tracked platforms generated more than $10 billion in notional volume over the weekend, a new record, with Kalshi accounting for roughly $7.9 billion across consecutive daily records. items.title: NFL files Supreme Court brief backing New Jersey in Kalshi sports contracts case
items.content_text: - **NFL files Supreme Court brief backing New Jersey in Kalshi sports contracts case** — The NFL filed an amicus brief on October 8 asking the Supreme Court to let states regulate prediction markets as gambling, supporting New Jersey's petition in its case against Kalshi. items.title: Kalshi traders price 85 percent chance the Fed holds rates in October after weak jobs report
items.content_text: - **Kalshi traders price 85 percent chance the Fed holds rates in October after weak jobs report** — Kalshi's October Fed market moved to an 85 percent chance of a hold after September payrolls rose by only 29,000, well below expectations, with unemployment at 4.2 percent. Hold odds had sat near 65 percent after the September 30 PCE inflation report. ([Crypto Briefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/kalshi-fed-hold-odds-weak-jobs-report/))

items.content_text: - **Polymarket partners with Nasdaq to launch private company prediction markets** — Polymarket has launched a new category of markets tied to private companies, developed with Nasdaq Private Market, which will provide underlying data and infrastructure. items.title: Backing Polymarket primary favorites would have lost 4 percent, Bitquery audit finds
items.content_text: - **Backing Polymarket primary favorites would have lost 4 percent, Bitquery audit finds** — A Bitquery scorecard dated October 9 found the highest-priced favorite won 238 of 273 scored 2026 US primaries, yet a hypothetical strategy of backing each favorite lost about 4 percent. Candidates priced at 90 cents or more won 177 of 182 races, while favorites between 50 and 90 cents won 71 percent. ([CryptoNews](https://cryptonews.net/news/finance/33567124/))
